periods.summary: Yagokoro meets Ikki's group at Ittousei while trying to investigate whether Kiriko and Moroboshi have a scandalous relationship. She explains that Moroboshi sometimes brings strong visitors to his family restaurant as a welcome. Later she asks Ikki about rumors that he fought Edelweiss and won; Ikki admits he fought her but denies winning or remembering enough detail for an article. Yagokoro reluctantly gives up the story and wishes him luck against Moroboshi.

key_events.summary: Meets Ikki at Ittousei and asks about the Edelweiss rumor.

relationships.byakuya-jounosaki: Interview subject whom she wants to present through an expert-focused article.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Original intended subject who went to Tokyo without notice.
relationships.momiji-asagi: Bukyoku star whose popularity Yagokoro mentions as easier but less interesting copy.

periods.summary: Yagokoro calls Byakuya to the Bukyoku newspaper-club room because Moroboshi has gone to Tokyo and cannot be interviewed. She wants a deep, expert-oriented article using Byakuya's analytical view of opponents. Her question about the strongest opponent prompts Byakuya to explain Moroboshi's terrifying ability to exceed prediction, providing important commentary on Moroboshi's nature.

key_events.summary: Conducts the interview that elicits Byakuya's Killer Instinct analysis.
